leadText: Meguro's Fire Blast! (Japanese: 目黒さんのだいもんじ！ MS. MEGURO used FIRE BLAST!) is the eighth episode of A Pocketful of Adventures. It first aired in Japan on December 8, 2023, and in the Middle East and North Africa on May 18, 2024.
